message:
fix(F1): restore intended UPLOAD_AND_HANDOFF.md + register f1_correction in MANIFEST

Root cause (forensically established): row-3 of UPLOAD_AND_HANDOFF.md was enriched
with the real commit SHA + PR #10 URL + live API verification AFTER commit b0e18219
existed (a commit cannot embed its own SHA); commit afa37b81 then updated MANIFEST.json
only, leaving the pre-enrichment 6,116 B doc on the branch while MANIFEST hashed the
final local 6,247 B version (71dd2cf6...) — also present in the local evidence ZIP.

Changes:
- UPLOAD_AND_HANDOFF.md: 6,116 B -> 6,247 B (intended final; row 3 now carries PR #10
  URL + head SHA + verification timestamp)
- MANIFEST.json: package_files hashes UNCHANGED (all 8 now MATCH); added f1_correction
  block + verify_manifest.py entry
- verify_manifest.py: new self-verifier (python3 verify_manifest.py -> exit 0)

No other file touched. No merge performed (merge decision stays with the owner).
